limitations: Historical dates and prior strategy outcomes have been examined repeatedly; this is exploratory validation, not an untouched holdout.
Current swap snapshot held constant over history, with historical constant EUR tick valuation. Daily historical financing and conversion rates unavailable.
MT5 returned invalid triple-day code7; explicit Wednesday triple assumption retained. Primary broker midnight GMT+3 with GMT+2 sensitivity; historical clock/DST policy not reconstructed.
Stress doubles commissions, adverse market/stop slippage and negative swap debits, leaves credits unchanged. Observed spreads unchanged; fallback1 to2 pips.
Independent continuous EUR10k accounts per window/model; no monthly resets or concurrent portfolio aggregation. Drawdown samples M1-close equity and actual fills; intrabar loss can be larger.
Historical margin, execution latency, missing liquidity, tick paths and changing broker stop/volume constraints not reconstructed. No live settings, bot or orders.

variants.triple_exit: SELL flat five minutes before a triple-weight rollover only
variants.one_unit_carry: SELL allowed one ordinary carry unit per position; exit before cumulative units exceed one
variants.avoid_late_sell_entries: Block new SELL entries in final90minutes before broker midnight; existing positions unchanged
variants.trail_gap_0_75: Original1.5R activation, tighter0.75R trailing gap; overnight allowed

plan.control_reuse: 24 unchanged accounts reused only after exact original-source, history and risk/signal configuration checks
plan.selection: Nominate highest earlier GMT+3 stressed net, including controls; ties lower M1 drawdown then name. Earlier may remain negative. Lock before later/full new-model results. All results disclosed; reused dates are not untouched holdout.
plan.success_diagnostics: Full normal/stressed positive under both clocks; later stress positive; compare stressed net with original and known SELL-flat control. Do not replace locked nominee using later results.
plan.live_status: Research policies only; core replay and live configurations unchanged; terminal initialization/order APIs forbidden.
